name: Nashville International Airport

runway.v: four runways; longest 13/31, 11,030 ft x 150 ft (about 3,362 m x 46 m); parallels 02L/20R 7,704 ft, 02C/20C and 02R/20L 8,001 ft

hours.v: airport open 24 hours, every day; control tower 24 hours
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

customs.v: CBP clears general aviation 15:00-21:00 Central time, 7 days a week (best window 18:00-21:00); office 14:00-22:00; ask CBP for permission to land during office hours at least 2 hours before leaving the foreign airport, arrival within +/-30 minutes

noise.v: military and aircraft over 12,500 lb may not fly practice approaches; no practice approaches 23:00-07:00 local; no flight over the main terminal

max_aircraft.v: terminal apron taxilanes Z, Y1, Y2 and Y (between Y3 and Y4) closed to wingspans over 118 ft; no 180-degree turns on asphalt by aircraft over 12,500 lb
max_aircraft.quote: CLSD TO WINGSPAN MORE THAN 118 FT.

notes: Runway, hours, fuel, size and noise remarks from the FAA US AIP Part 3 AD 2 Tennessee page (no amendment date shown). Customs from the CBP KBNA GA Airport Fact Sheet of 15 Nov 2024 (KBNA-1124, hours effective 17 Nov 2024); a newer sheet may exist. FAA Flight Deck page for BNA (last updated 9 Jun 2026, kbna-faa-flightdeck) confirms 'BNA ATCT Operates: 24 hours.' and no practice approaches or pattern work 23:00-07:00 local. No curfew statement found either way. PPR in the AIP applies to airline gate ramp entry and the Air National Guard, so not recorded. IATA: the FAA Flight Deck page title shows (BNA). Chart Supplement (aeronav.faa.gov) not opened.
